import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Data.Vector.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Vector.Sort
import Mathlib.Data.RBMap
import Mathlib.Data.RBMap.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.List.Sort
import Mathlib.Data.Array.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Array.Init
import Mathlib.Data.ByteArray
import Mathlib.Init.Data.Nat.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Init.Data.Int.Lemmas
import Mathlib.Control.Monad
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Int.Basic

namespace ChaosCore

def BLOCK_ID_SIZE : Nat := 16
def CONTENT_HASH_SIZE : Nat := 16
def SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE : Nat := 32
def DEFAULT_BLOCK_SIZE : Nat := 1048576
def OPTIMIZATION_THRESHOLD : Float := 0.6
def LOAD_HIGH_THRESHOLD : Float := 1.3
def LOAD_LOW_THRESHOLD : Float := 0.7
def BALANCE_INTERVAL_CYCLES : Nat := 100

abbrev BlockId := Vector UInt8 BLOCK_ID_SIZE
abbrev ContentHash := Vector UInt8 CONTENT_HASH_SIZE
abbrev TaskId := Vector UInt8 SHA256_DIGEST_SIZE

instance : Ord BlockId where
  compare a b := match Vector.compare a b with
    | .lt => Ordering.lt
    | .eq => Ordering.eq
    | .gt => Ordering.gt

instance : Hashable BlockId where
  hash a := a.foldl (fun acc x => acc * 31 + x.toNat) 0

instance : BEq BlockId := Vector.instBEq

instance : Ord ContentHash := inferInstance
instance : Hashable ContentHash := inferInstance
instance : BEq ContentHash := inferInstance

instance : Ord TaskId := inferInstance
instance : Hashable TaskId := inferInstance
instance : BEq TaskId := inferInstance

inductive MemoryBlockState where
  | free
  | allocated
  | entangled
  | migrating
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

inductive CoreState where
  | idle
  | active
  | powerGated
  | stalled
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

structure AccessRecord where
  timestamp : Int
  coreId : Nat
deriving Inhabited

structure MemoryBlock where
  blockId : BlockId
  contentHash : ContentHash
  data : ByteArray
  size : Nat
  state : MemoryBlockState
  affinityCore : Option Nat
  accessCount : Nat
  lastAccessTime : Int
  entangledBlocks : RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)
deriving Inhabited

structure TaskDescriptor where
  taskId : TaskId
  priority : Int
  dataDependencies : Array BlockId
  estimatedCycles : Nat
  assignedCore : Option Nat
  completionStatus : Bool
  startTime : Int
  endTime : Int
deriving Inhabited

structure ProcessingCore where
  coreId : Nat
  state : CoreState
  cyclesActive : Nat
  cyclesIdle : Nat
deriving Inhabited

structure ContentAddressableStorage where
  storage : RBMap BlockId MemoryBlock (fun a b => compare a b)
  contentIndex : RBMap ContentHash (RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)) (fun a b => compare a b)
  affinityMap : RBMap Nat (RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)) Nat.compare
  totalCapacity : Nat
  usedCapacity : Nat
deriving Inhabited

structure SchedulerState where
  pendingTasks : RBMap TaskId TaskDescriptor (fun a b => compare a b)
  activeTasks : RBMap TaskId TaskDescriptor (fun a b => compare a b)
  completedTasks : Array TaskDescriptor
  taskCounter : Nat
deriving Inhabited

structure DataFlowAnalyzer where
  flowGraph : RBMap BlockId (RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b)) (fun a b => compare a b)
  flowWeights : RBMap (BlockId × BlockId) Float (fun a b => compare a.fst b.fst) -- Simplified comparator
  accessPatterns : RBMap BlockId (Array AccessRecord) (fun a b => compare a b)
deriving Inhabited

structure KernelState where
  storage : ContentAddressableStorage
  scheduler : SchedulerState
  flowAnalyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer
  cores : RBMap Nat ProcessingCore Nat.compare
  cycleCount : Nat
  migrationCount : Nat
  currentTime : Int
deriving Inhabited

def compareBlockId (a b : BlockId) : Ordering := compare a b
def compareContentHash (a b : ContentHash) : Ordering := compare a b
def compareTaskId (a b : TaskId) : Ordering := compare a b
def compareNat (a b : Nat) : Ordering := if a < b then .lt else if a > b then .gt else .eq

def emptyBlockIdSet : RBMap BlockId Unit (fun a b => compare a b) := RBMap.empty

def emptyCAS (cap : Nat) : ContentAddressableStorage := {
  storage := RBMap.empty,
  contentIndex := RBMap.empty,
  affinityMap := RBMap.empty,
  totalCapacity := cap,
  usedCapacity := 0
}

def emptyScheduler : SchedulerState := {
  pendingTasks := RBMap.empty,
  activeTasks := RBMap.empty,
  completedTasks := #[],
  taskCounter := 0
}

def emptyAnalyzer : DataFlowAnalyzer := {
  flowGraph := RBMap.empty,
  flowWeights := RBMap.empty,
  accessPatterns := RBMap.empty
}

def emptyKernel (cap : Nat) : KernelState := {
  storage := emptyCAS cap,
  scheduler := emptyScheduler,
  flowAnalyzer := emptyAnalyzer,
  cores := RBMap.empty,
  cycleCount := 0,
  migrationCount := 0,
  currentTime := 0
}

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ContentHash :=
  let dataArray := data.toList
  let v := Vector.ofFn (fun i => if i < dataArray.length then dataArray.get! i else 0) CONTENT_HASH_SIZE
  v

def computeBlockId (ch : ContentHash) (ts : Int) : BlockId :=
  let chBytes := ch.toList
  let tsBytes := (ts.toNat.toDigits 10).map (fun d => d.toUInt8) -- Mock timestamp serialization
  let combined := chBytes ++ tsBytes
  let combinedVec := Vector.ofFn (fun i => if i < combined.length then combined.get! i else 0) BLOCK_ID_SIZE
  combinedVec

def MemoryBlock.init (id : BlockId) (ch : ContentHash) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) : MemoryBlock :=
  {
    blockId := id,
    contentHash := ch,
    data := data,
    size := data.size,
    state := MemoryBlockState.allocated,
    affinityCore := prefCore,
    accessCount := 1,
    lastAccessTime := time,
    entangledBlocks := RBMap.empty
  }

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { coreId := id, state := CoreState.idle, cyclesActive := 0, cyclesIdle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (core : ProcessingCore) (isActive : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if isActive then
    { core with cyclesActive := core.cyclesActive + 1, state := CoreState.active }
  else
    { core with cyclesIdle := core.cyclesIdle + 1, state := if core.state = CoreState.powerGated then CoreState.powerGated else CoreState.idle }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (core : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := core.cyclesActive + core.cyclesIdle
  if total = 0 then 0.0 else (core.cyclesActive : Float) / (total : Float)

def CASInvariants (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) : Prop :=
  cas.usedCapacity ≤ cas.totalCapacity ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    (∀ (eid : BlockId), blk.entangledBlocks.contains eid → cas.storage.contains eid)) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    cas.contentIndex.find blk.contentHash |>.getD RBMap.empty |>.contains id) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    match blk.affinityCore with
    | none => True
    | some c => cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty |>.contains id)

theorem emptyCAS_inv (cap : Nat) : CASInvariants (emptyCAS cap) := by
  unfold emptyCAS CASInvariants
  constructor
  . simp
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h

def CAS.store (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) :
    Except String (ContentAddressableStorage × BlockId) :=
  let ch := computeContentHash data
  match cas.contentIndex.find ch with
  | some idSet =>
    match idSet.toList.findSome? (fun id => cas.storage.find id) with
    | some blk =>
      let updatedBlk := { blk with accessCount := blk.accessCount + 1, lastAccessTime := time }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert blk.blockId updatedBlk
      let newCAS := { cas with storage := newStorage }
      Except.ok (newCAS, blk.blockId)
    | none =>
      if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "OutOfMemory"
      else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "NeedEviction"
      else
        let ts := time
        let bid := computeBlockId ch ts
        let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
        let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
        let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch (idSet.insert bid ())
        let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
          | none => cas.affinityMap
          | some c =>
             let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
             cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
        let newCAS := {
          storage := newStorage,
          contentIndex := newContentIndex,
          affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
          totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
          usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
        }
        Except.ok (newCAS, bid)
  | none =>
    if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
      Except.error "OutOfMemory"
    else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
       Except.error "NeedEviction"
    else
      let ts := time
      let bid := computeBlockId ch ts
      let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
      let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch (RBMap.empty.insert bid ())
      let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
           let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
           cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
      let newCAS := {
        storage := newStorage,
        contentIndex := newContentIndex,
        affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
        totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
        usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
      }
      Except.ok (newCAS, bid)

theorem CAS.store_capacity_check (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) (t : Int) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    match CAS.store cas data pref t with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (cas', _) => cas'.usedCapacity ≤ cas'.totalCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.store
  split
  . next => 
    split
    . next =>
      intro h_find
      split
      . next h_existing =>
        constructor <;> try trivial
        rw [h_inv.1]
      . next h_none =>
        split
        . next => trivial
        . next h_need_evict => trivial
        . next h_ok =>
          cases h_ok
          constructor
          linarith
    . next => trivial
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    . next h_err => trivial
    . next h_need_evict => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      constructor
      linarith

def CAS.retrieve (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | some blk => some blk.data
  | none => none

def CAS.entangleBlocks (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if bid1 = bid2 then
    Except.error "SameBlock"
  else
    match cas.storage.find bid1, cas.storage.find bid2 with
    | some blk1, some blk2 =>
      let newBlk1 := { blk1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk1.entangledBlocks.insert bid2 () }
      let newBlk2 := { blk2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk2.entangledBlocks.insert bid1 () }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid1 newBlk1 |>.insert bid2 newBlk2
      pure { cas with storage := newStorage }
    | _, _ => Except.error "BlockNotFound"

theorem CAS.entangleBlocks_symmetric (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) (h_ne : bid1 ≠ bid2) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.entangleBlocks cas bid1 bid2
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' =>
        (cas'.storage.find bid1).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true ∧
        (cas'.storage.find bid2).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.entangleBlocks
  split
  . next h_eq => contradiction h_eq h_ne
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i blk1 blk2
    constructor <;> simp [RBMap.insert]

def CAS.migrateBlock (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (targetCore : Nat) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | none => Except.error "BlockNotFound"
  | some blk =>
      let oldCore := blk.affinityCore
      let affinityMap1 := match oldCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
            let s := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
            let s' := s.erase bid
            if s'.isEmpty then cas.affinityMap.erase c else cas.affinityMap.insert c s'
      
      let blkMigrating := { blk with state := MemoryBlockState.migrating, affinityCore := some targetCore }
      let storage1 := cas.storage.insert bid blkMigrating
      
      let am := affinityMap1.find targetCore |>.getD RBMap.empty
      let affinityMap2 := affinityMap1.insert targetCore (am.insert bid ())
      
      let blkFinal := { blkMigrating with state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
      let storageFinal := storage1.insert bid blkFinal
      
      pure { cas with storage := storageFinal, affinityMap := affinityMap2 }

theorem CAS.migrateBlock_updates_affinity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.migrateBlock cas bid tid
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' => (cas'.storage.find bid).map (fun b => b.affinityCore = some tid) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => trivial
  . next blk =>
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next oc =>
      split <;> try trivial
      rename_i h_empty
      split <;> try trivial
      simp [RBMap.insert]

def Scheduler.submit (sched : SchedulerState) (prio : Int) (deps : Array BlockId) (est : Nat) (tid : TaskId) : SchedulerState :=
  let task : TaskDescriptor := {
    taskId := tid,
    priority := prio,
    dataDependencies := deps,
    estimatedCycles := est,
    assignedCore := none,
    completionStatus := false,
    startTime := 0,
    endTime := 0
  }
  { sched with pendingTasks := sched.pendingTasks.insert tid task }

def Scheduler.pickNext (sched : SchedulerState) : Option (TaskId × TaskDescriptor) :=
  if h : sched.pendingTasks.isEmpty then none else
    let res := sched.pendingTasks.fold (fun acc tid task =>
      match acc with
      | none => some (tid, task)
      | some (bestTid, bestTask) =>
        if task.priority > bestTask.priority then some (tid, task) else acc
    ) none
    res

def Scheduler.schedule (sched : SchedulerState) (cores : RBMap Nat ProcessingCore Nat.compare) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : (SchedulerState × Option (TaskId × Nat)) :=
  match Scheduler.pickNext sched with
  | none => (sched, none)
  | some (tid, task) =>
      match cores.findSome? (fun cid ccore => if ccore.state = CoreState.powerGated then none else some (cid, ccore)) with
      | none => (sched, none)
      | some (cid, _) =>
          let activeTask := { task with assignedCore := some cid, startTime := time }
          let newPending := sched.pendingTasks.erase tid
          let newActive := sched.activeTasks.insert tid activeTask
          let newSched := { sched with pendingTasks := newPending, activeTasks := newActive }
          (newSched, some (tid, cid))

def Scheduler.complete (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) : SchedulerState :=
  match sched.activeTasks.find tid with
  | none => sched
  | some task =>
      let completedTask := { task with completionStatus := true, endTime := time }
      let newActive := sched.activeTasks.erase tid
      let newSched := { sched with activeTasks := newActive, completedTasks := sched.completedTasks.push completedTask }
      newSched

theorem Scheduler.complete_moves_to_completed (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) :
    (Scheduler.complete sched tid time).completedTasks.size = sched.completedTasks.size + (if sched.activeTasks.contains tid then 1 else 0) := by
  unfold Scheduler.complete
  split
  . next => simp
  . next task =>
    simp

def Kernel.executeCycle (k : KernelState) : KernelState :=
  let (sched, scheduledInfo) := Scheduler.schedule k.scheduler k.cores k.storage k.currentTime
  let cores' := k.cores.map (fun cid core =>
      let isActive := match scheduledInfo with
        | some (t, c) => c = cid
        | none => false
      core.tick isActive
    )
  let k' := { k with scheduler := sched, cores := cores', cycleCount := k.cycleCount + 1 }
  k'

theorem Kernel.executeCycle_increases_count (k : KernelState) :
    (Kernel.executeCycle k).cycleCount = k.cycleCount + 1 := by
  unfold Kernel.executeCycle
  simp

def Kernel.addCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.insert id (ProcessingCore.init id) }

theorem Kernel.addCore_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    (Kernel.addCore k id).cores.contains id := by
  unfold Kernel.addCore
  simp [RBMap.insert]

def Kernel.removeCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.erase id }

theorem Kernel.removeCore_not_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    ¬((Kernel.removeCore k id).cores.contains id) := by
  unfold Kernel.removeCore
  simp

def Kernel.allocateMemory (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) : Except String (KernelState × BlockId) :=
  match CAS.store k.storage data prefCore k.currentTime with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok (newCAS, bid) =>
      Except.ok ({ k with storage := newCAS }, bid)

theorem Kernel.allocateMemory_increases_storage (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    data.size ≤ k.storage.totalCapacity →
    match Kernel.allocateMemory k data pref with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (k', _) => k'.storage.usedCapacity ≥ k.storage.usedCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cap
  unfold Kernel.allocateMemory
  split <;> try trivial
  rename_i newCAS bid h_store
  unfold CAS.store at h_store
  split at h_store <;> try trivial
  . next =>
    split at h_store <;> try trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      simp
  . next =>
    split at h_store <;> try trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      simp

def Kernel.readMemory (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  CAS.retrieve k.storage bid

def Kernel.entangleData (k : KernelState) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.entangleBlocks k.storage bid1 bid2 with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS }

def Kernel.migrateBlock (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.migrateBlock k.storage bid tid with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS, migrationCount := k.migrationCount + 1 }

theorem Kernel.migrateBlock_increases_count (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    k.storage.contains bid →
    match Kernel.migrateBlock k bid tid with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok k' => k'.migrationCount = k.migrationCount + 1
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cont
  unfold Kernel.migrateBlock
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => contradiction h_cont (by simp)
  . next blk =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i h_new
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next =>
      split <;> try trivial
      . next => trivial
      . next => trivial

end ChaosCore

def computeContentHash (data : ByteArray) : ContentHash :=
  let dataArray := data.toList
  let v := Vector.ofFn (fun i => if i < dataArray.length then dataArray.get! i else 0) CONTENT_HASH_SIZE
  v

def computeBlockId (ch : ContentHash) (ts : Int) : BlockId :=
  let chBytes := ch.toList
  let tsBytes := (ts.toNat.toDigits 10).map (fun d => d.toUInt8) -- Mock timestamp serialization
  let combined := chBytes ++ tsBytes
  let combinedVec := Vector.ofFn (fun i => if i < combined.length then combined.get! i else 0) BLOCK_ID_SIZE
  combinedVec

def MemoryBlock.init (id : BlockId) (ch : ContentHash) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) : MemoryBlock :=
  {
    blockId := id,
    contentHash := ch,
    data := data,
    size := data.size,
    state := MemoryBlockState.allocated,
    affinityCore := prefCore,
    accessCount := 1,
    lastAccessTime := time,
    entangledBlocks := RBMap.empty
  }

def ProcessingCore.init (id : Nat) : ProcessingCore :=
  { coreId := id, state := CoreState.idle, cyclesActive := 0, cyclesIdle := 0 }

def ProcessingCore.tick (core : ProcessingCore) (isActive : Bool) : ProcessingCore :=
  if isActive then
    { core with cyclesActive := core.cyclesActive + 1, state := CoreState.active }
  else
    { core with cyclesIdle := core.cyclesIdle + 1, state := if core.state = CoreState.powerGated then CoreState.powerGated else CoreState.idle }

def ProcessingCore.getWorkload (core : ProcessingCore) : Float :=
  let total := core.cyclesActive + core.cyclesIdle
  if total = 0 then 0.0 else (core.cyclesActive : Float) / (total : Float)

def CASInvariants (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) : Prop :=
  cas.usedCapacity ≤ cas.totalCapacity ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    (∀ (eid : BlockId), blk.entangledBlocks.contains eid → cas.storage.contains eid)) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    cas.contentIndex.find blk.contentHash |>.getD RBMap.empty |>.contains id) ∧
  (∀ (id : BlockId) (blk : MemoryBlock), cas.storage.find id = some blk →
    match blk.affinityCore with
    | none => True
    | some c => cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty |>.contains id)

theorem emptyCAS_inv (cap : Nat) : CASInvariants (emptyCAS cap) := by
  unfold emptyCAS CASInvariants
  constructor
  . simp
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h
  . intro id blk h
    cases h

def CAS.store (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) (time : Int) :
    Except String (ContentAddressableStorage × BlockId) :=
  let ch := computeContentHash data
  match cas.contentIndex.find ch with
  | some idSet =>
    match idSet.toList.findSome? (fun id => cas.storage.find id) with
    | some blk =>
      let updatedBlk := { blk with accessCount := blk.accessCount + 1, lastAccessTime := time }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert blk.blockId updatedBlk
      let newCAS := { cas with storage := newStorage }
      Except.ok (newCAS, blk.blockId)
    | none =>
      if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "OutOfMemory"
      else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
        Except.error "NeedEviction"
      else
        let ts := time
        let bid := computeBlockId ch ts
        let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
        let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
        let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch (idSet.insert bid ())
        let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
          | none => cas.affinityMap
          | some c =>
             let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
             cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
        let newCAS := {
          storage := newStorage,
          contentIndex := newContentIndex,
          affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
          totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
          usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
        }
        Except.ok (newCAS, bid)
  | none =>
    if data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
      Except.error "OutOfMemory"
    else if cas.usedCapacity + data.size > cas.totalCapacity then
       Except.error "NeedEviction"
    else
      let ts := time
      let bid := computeBlockId ch ts
      let blk := MemoryBlock.init bid ch data prefCore time
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid blk
      let newContentIndex := cas.contentIndex.insert ch (RBMap.empty.insert bid ())
      let newAffinityMap := match prefCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
           let am := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
           cas.affinityMap.insert c (am.insert bid ())
      let newCAS := {
        storage := newStorage,
        contentIndex := newContentIndex,
        affinityMap := newAffinityMap,
        totalCapacity := cas.totalCapacity,
        usedCapacity := cas.usedCapacity + data.size
      }
      Except.ok (newCAS, bid)

theorem CAS.store_capacity_check (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) (t : Int) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    match CAS.store cas data pref t with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (cas', _) => cas'.usedCapacity ≤ cas'.totalCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.store
  split
  . next => 
    split
    . next =>
      intro h_find
      split
      . next h_existing =>
        constructor <;> try trivial
        rw [h_inv.1]
      . next h_none =>
        split
        . next => trivial
        . next h_need_evict => trivial
        . next h_ok =>
          cases h_ok
          constructor
          linarith
    . next => trivial
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    . next h_err => trivial
    . next h_need_evict => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      constructor
      linarith

def CAS.retrieve (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | some blk => some blk.data
  | none => none

def CAS.entangleBlocks (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  if bid1 = bid2 then
    Except.error "SameBlock"
  else
    match cas.storage.find bid1, cas.storage.find bid2 with
    | some blk1, some blk2 =>
      let newBlk1 := { blk1 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk1.entangledBlocks.insert bid2 () }
      let newBlk2 := { blk2 with state := MemoryBlockState.entangled, entangledBlocks := blk2.entangledBlocks.insert bid1 () }
      let newStorage := cas.storage.insert bid1 newBlk1 |>.insert bid2 newBlk2
      pure { cas with storage := newStorage }
    | _, _ => Except.error "BlockNotFound"

theorem CAS.entangleBlocks_symmetric (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) (h_ne : bid1 ≠ bid2) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.entangleBlocks cas bid1 bid2
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' =>
        (cas'.storage.find bid1).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true ∧
        (cas'.storage.find bid2).map (fun b => b.state = MemoryBlockState.entangled) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.entangleBlocks
  split
  . next h_eq => contradiction h_eq h_ne
  . next =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i blk1 blk2
    constructor <;> simp [RBMap.insert]

def CAS.migrateBlock (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (targetCore : Nat) : Except String ContentAddressableStorage :=
  match cas.storage.find bid with
  | none => Except.error "BlockNotFound"
  | some blk =>
      let oldCore := blk.affinityCore
      let affinityMap1 := match oldCore with
        | none => cas.affinityMap
        | some c =>
            let s := cas.affinityMap.find c |>.getD RBMap.empty
            let s' := s.erase bid
            if s'.isEmpty then cas.affinityMap.erase c else cas.affinityMap.insert c s'
      
      let blkMigrating := { blk with state := MemoryBlockState.migrating, affinityCore := some targetCore }
      let storage1 := cas.storage.insert bid blkMigrating
      
      let am := affinityMap1.find targetCore |>.getD RBMap.empty
      let affinityMap2 := affinityMap1.insert targetCore (am.insert bid ())
      
      let blkFinal := { blkMigrating with state := MemoryBlockState.allocated }
      let storageFinal := storage1.insert bid blkFinal
      
      pure { cas with storage := storageFinal, affinityMap := affinityMap2 }

theorem CAS.migrateBlock_updates_affinity (cas : ContentAddressableStorage) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants cas →
    let res := CAS.migrateBlock cas bid tid
    match res with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok cas' => (cas'.storage.find bid).map (fun b => b.affinityCore = some tid) = some true
    := by
  intro h_inv
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => trivial
  . next blk =>
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next oc =>
      split <;> try trivial
      rename_i h_empty
      split <;> try trivial
      simp [RBMap.insert]

def Scheduler.submit (sched : SchedulerState) (prio : Int) (deps : Array BlockId) (est : Nat) (tid : TaskId) : SchedulerState :=
  let task : TaskDescriptor := {
    taskId := tid,
    priority := prio,
    dataDependencies := deps,
    estimatedCycles := est,
    assignedCore := none,
    completionStatus := false,
    startTime := 0,
    endTime := 0
  }
  { sched with pendingTasks := sched.pendingTasks.insert tid task }

def Scheduler.pickNext (sched : SchedulerState) : Option (TaskId × TaskDescriptor) :=
  if h : sched.pendingTasks.isEmpty then none else
    let res := sched.pendingTasks.fold (fun acc tid task =>
      match acc with
      | none => some (tid, task)
      | some (bestTid, bestTask) =>
        if task.priority > bestTask.priority then some (tid, task) else acc
    ) none
    res

def Scheduler.schedule (sched : SchedulerState) (cores : RBMap Nat ProcessingCore Nat.compare) (storage : ContentAddressableStorage) (time : Int) : (SchedulerState × Option (TaskId × Nat)) :=
  match Scheduler.pickNext sched with
  | none => (sched, none)
  | some (tid, task) =>
      match cores.findSome? (fun cid ccore => if ccore.state = CoreState.powerGated then none else some (cid, ccore)) with
      | none => (sched, none)
      | some (cid, _) =>
          let activeTask := { task with assignedCore := some cid, startTime := time }
          let newPending := sched.pendingTasks.erase tid
          let newActive := sched.activeTasks.insert tid activeTask
          let newSched := { sched with pendingTasks := newPending, activeTasks := newActive }
          (newSched, some (tid, cid))

def Scheduler.complete (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) : SchedulerState :=
  match sched.activeTasks.find tid with
  | none => sched
  | some task =>
      let completedTask := { task with completionStatus := true, endTime := time }
      let newActive := sched.activeTasks.erase tid
      let newSched := { sched with activeTasks := newActive, completedTasks := sched.completedTasks.push completedTask }
      newSched

theorem Scheduler.complete_moves_to_completed (sched : SchedulerState) (tid : TaskId) (time : Int) :
    (Scheduler.complete sched tid time).completedTasks.size = sched.completedTasks.size + (if sched.activeTasks.contains tid then 1 else 0) := by
  unfold Scheduler.complete
  split
  . next => simp
  . next task =>
    simp

def Kernel.executeCycle (k : KernelState) : KernelState :=
  let (sched, scheduledInfo) := Scheduler.schedule k.scheduler k.cores k.storage k.currentTime
  let cores' := k.cores.map (fun cid core =>
      let isActive := match scheduledInfo with
        | some (t, c) => c = cid
        | none => false
      core.tick isActive
    )
  let k' := { k with scheduler := sched, cores := cores', cycleCount := k.cycleCount + 1 }
  k'

theorem Kernel.executeCycle_increases_count (k : KernelState) :
    (Kernel.executeCycle k).cycleCount = k.cycleCount + 1 := by
  unfold Kernel.executeCycle
  simp

def Kernel.addCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.insert id (ProcessingCore.init id) }

theorem Kernel.addCore_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    (Kernel.addCore k id).cores.contains id := by
  unfold Kernel.addCore
  simp [RBMap.insert]

def Kernel.removeCore (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) : KernelState :=
  { k with cores := k.cores.erase id }

theorem Kernel.removeCore_not_contains (k : KernelState) (id : Nat) :
    ¬((Kernel.removeCore k id).cores.contains id) := by
  unfold Kernel.removeCore
  simp

def Kernel.allocateMemory (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (prefCore : Option Nat) : Except String (KernelState × BlockId) :=
  match CAS.store k.storage data prefCore k.currentTime with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok (newCAS, bid) =>
      Except.ok ({ k with storage := newCAS }, bid)

theorem Kernel.allocateMemory_increases_storage (k : KernelState) (data : ByteArray) (pref : Option Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    data.size ≤ k.storage.totalCapacity →
    match Kernel.allocateMemory k data pref with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok (k', _) => k'.storage.usedCapacity ≥ k.storage.usedCapacity
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cap
  unfold Kernel.allocateMemory
  split <;> try trivial
  rename_i newCAS bid h_store
  unfold CAS.store at h_store
  split at h_store <;> try trivial
  . next =>
    split at h_store <;> try trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      simp
  . next =>
    split at h_store <;> try trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next => trivial
    . next h_ok =>
      cases h_ok
      simp

def Kernel.readMemory (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) : Option ByteArray :=
  CAS.retrieve k.storage bid

def Kernel.entangleData (k : KernelState) (bid1 bid2 : BlockId) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.entangleBlocks k.storage bid1 bid2 with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS }

def Kernel.migrateBlock (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) : Except String KernelState :=
  match CAS.migrateBlock k.storage bid tid with
  | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | Except.ok newCAS => Except.ok { k with storage := newCAS, migrationCount := k.migrationCount + 1 }

theorem Kernel.migrateBlock_increases_count (k : KernelState) (bid : BlockId) (tid : Nat) :
    CASInvariants k.storage →
    k.storage.contains bid →
    match Kernel.migrateBlock k bid tid with
    | Except.error _ => True
    | Except.ok k' => k'.migrationCount = k.migrationCount + 1
    := by
  intro h_inv h_cont
  unfold Kernel.migrateBlock
  unfold CAS.migrateBlock
  split
  . next => contradiction h_cont (by simp)
  . next blk =>
    split <;> try trivial
    rename_i h_new
    cases blk.affinityCore <;> try trivial
    . next =>
      split <;> try trivial
      . next => trivial
      . next => trivial

end ChaosCore
entries.answer:
Ez a kódrészlet túlnyomórészt **valós Lean/Mathlib definíciók és részben formális (taktikával levezetett) tételek keveréke**, de több helyen a “formális verifikáció” inkább csak részleges, sőt néhol kifejezetten törékeny/hibás bizonyításváz vagy „mock” jellegű modell (pl. a hash és blokkazonosító képzése).[1]

## Mitől “valós” benne a formalizáció?
A `structure`-ök, az `inductive` állapottípusok, az `RBMap`-okra épített állapotreprezentáció, valamint az olyan egyszerű tételek, mint `emptyCAS_inv`, `Kernel.executeCycle_increases_count`, `Kernel.addCore_contains`, `Kernel.removeCore_not_contains` tipikusan teljesen formális Lean-állítások, amelyeket a kernel képes ellenőrizni, ha a bizonyítások tényleg jól vannak megírva.[1]

Különösen a “szintaktikailag kiszámítható” bizonyítások (sok `simp`, `unfold`, `cases`, `split`) valódi, gép által ellenőrzött levezetések szoktak lenni, mert a Lean ezeknél konkrét definícióegyenleteket és simp-lemmasorokat alkalmaz.[2][3]

## Hol inkább mock / placeholder?
A `computeContentHash` és `computeBlockId` nem kriptográfiai hash és nem determinisztikusan/ütközésmentesen tervezett azonosító-képzés, hanem egyszerű byte-kivágás/kitöltés, illetve “timestamp digits” összefűzés, ami egy demonstrációs placeholder modell tipikus jele.[4]

Ezen túl az `RBMap`-os összehasonlítók környékén is van “egyszerűsítés”: például `flowWeights : RBMap (BlockId × BlockId) Float (fun a b => compare a.fst b.fst)` összehasonlítója csak az első komponenst nézi, ami azt jelenti, hogy különböző `(fst, snd)` párok “összeeshetnek” ugyanarra a kulcsosztályra, ami logikai modellként erősen gyanús (és könnyen hibás invariánsokhoz vezet).[5]

## A bizonyítások minősége: formális-e, vagy csak “ránézésre”?
A Lean-ben akkor “valós formális verifikáció” egy tétel, ha tényleg típushelyes és a kernel elfogadja; viszont attól, hogy van `theorem ... := by ...`, még lehet hibás/meg nem születő bizonyítás (pl. rossz `split`-struktúra, rossz ágak, téves `linarith`).[5]

A te konkrét tételeid közül többnél látszik a taktikai szerkezet, de van néhány piros zászló: például a `CAS.store_capacity_check` bizonyításában olyan minták jelennek meg (`constructor` egy `Prop`-hoz, majd `rw [h_inv.1]` stb.), amelyek könnyen félremehetnek, ha a cél valójában nem konjunkció abban az ágban, vagy a `split` nem a megfelelő kifejezésen történik.[5]

## RBMap műveletek és “simp” realitása
Az `RBMap.contains` definíciója ténylegesen `find?`-re és `Option.isSome`-ra épül, tehát az olyan célok, mint “insert után contains igaz” vagy “erase után not contains” gyakran `simp`-pel is mennek, ha a megfelelő simp-lemma elérhető és a kulcs-összehasonlító rendben van.[1]

Ugyanakkor a `RBMap.insert`/`erase` viselkedése sokszor nem olyan “szabadon szimplifikálható”, mint egy `Std`-beli `Finmap`, ezért előfordulhat, hogy a `simp [RBMap.insert]` nem fogja azt adni, amit intuícióból vársz, vagy extra lemmák kellenek.[1]

## Mit kérdezzek vissza, hogy biztosat mondjak?
Szeretnéd, hogy konkrétan megmondjam: **a fenti fájl Lean-ben jelenleg lefordul-e**, és ha nem, hol törik el (melyik `theorem`/definíció)? Ehhez az kell, hogy megírd: melyik Lean+mathlib verziót célzod (pl. lakefile/mathlib commit), és van-e fordítási logod.

Ahhoz, hogy tényleg meg tudjam mondani, **lefordul-e** ez a fájl, és ha nem, *pontosan hol* törik el, kell tőled 2–3 konkrétum (különben csak valószínűsíteni lehet, nem “formálisan verifikálni”). A Lean ezt mindig a pontos toolchain + mathlib commit függvényében dönti el.[1]

## Mit küldj el
Írd meg (vagy másold be) a projektedből:

1) `lakefile.lean` (vagy `lakefile.toml`) és a `lean-toolchain` fájl tartalmát, mert ez rögzíti a Lean verziót és a mathlib snapshotot/commitot.[2][1]

2) A pontos fordítási parancsot és a logot: pl. `lake build` kimenete, vagy VS Code “Lean: Restart File” után a *legelső* error message teljes szövege (a sor/oszlop pozícióval).[2]

3) Ha van, a fájl neve + elérési útja a projekten belül (pl. `ChaosCore.lean`), hogy ugyanabban a modulhierarchiában legyen értelmezve, mint nálad.[2]

## Mit fogok ellenőrizni a log alapján
Az első körben azt nézem, hogy nem a környezet a gond (hibás mathlib import, eltérő `RBMap` API, `Batteries` vs `Lean.Data.RBMap`, stb.), mert az `RBMap` definíciói és egyenletei verziófüggők, és a `simp`-el támasztott “automatikus” lépések emiatt könnyen eltörnek.[3][4]

A második körben a tipikus töréspontok: (a) `Vector.compare`/`Ord` instanciák és azok redukciója, (b) `RBMap.insert/erase/contains/isEmpty`-hez hiányzó lemmák, (c) túl optimista `split`-ek és `constructor`-ozás ott, ahol a cél nem konjunkció, (d) `linarith` olyan ágban, ahol nincs megfelelő lineáris aritmetikai cél/hipotézis.[4][5][6]

## Miért nem tudom most azonnal kijelenteni, hogy “igen, lefordul”
A kódban több olyan rész van, ami *nagyon érzékeny* a mathlib/Lean definícióegyenleteire (különösen `RBMap`-os `simp [RBMap.insert]`-ek), és ezeknél a legkisebb API-eltérés is konkrét fordítási hibát ad.[7][4]

Ha átküldöd a fenti 1)–2) pontot, megmondom, hogy ez nálad **valós, kernel által elfogadott bizonyítás-e**, vagy csak olyan “bizonyításnak látszó” taktikai script, ami a jelen toolchainen valójában elhasal.[2]

entries.answer:
Akkor így: **Lake projektfájlok nélkül** ezt a Mathlib-importos Lean fájlt “csak úgy” nem nagyon lehet megbízhatóan lefordítani, mert a `import Mathlib...`-hez kell egy rögzített Lean+mathlib toolchain és a megfelelő keresési útvonalak.[1][2]

## Minimál setup (2 fájl, ennyi)
Hozz létre egy mappát (pl. `ChaosCoreCheck/`), tedd bele a te `.lean` fájlodat (pl. `ChaosCore.lean`), és mellé ezt a két fájlt.

**1) `lean-toolchain`**  
Másold be a mathlib által ajánlott toolchaint (a wiki szerint ezt tipikusan a mathlib repo `lean-toolchain` fájljából szokás átvenni).[2]

**2) `lakefile.lean` vagy `lakefile.toml`**  
A mathlib wiki hivatalos útja az, hogy Lake projektet hozol létre, ami `require "leanprover-community" / "mathlib"` függőséggel felveszi a Mathlib-et.[3][2]

Ha a legegyszerűbbet akarod, futtasd a terminálban a mappa felett:
`lake +leanprover-community/mathlib4:lean-toolchain new ChaosCoreCheck math`  
Ez létrehozza a szükséges fájlokat és beállítja a mathlib függőséget.[4][2]

## Fordítás gyorsítással
A mathlib wiki javasolja a cache használatát, különben sokat fog fordítani: a projekt gyökerében `lake exe cache get`.[2]

Ezután `lake build` (vagy VS Code-ban megnyitod a fájlt), és megkapod a konkrét hibát, ha van.[5][2]

## Mit küldj vissza, és megmondom “lefordul-e”
Másold be ide a **legelső** error-t a kimenetből (sor/oszlop + üzenet), vagy ha nincs hiba, akkor írd meg, hogy a `lake build` sikeres volt.[5]

Plusz egy kérdés: milyen néven mentetted a fájlt (pl. `ChaosCore.lean`), és a tetején a `namespace ChaosCore` előtt van-e bármi extra?
